The provided code independently verifies finite instances; finite evidence is not used to infer the infinite result.

value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly leaves distributional questions about the new Möbius-star function and computes only its total support density. Distinguishing the two signs in each progression and calculating the exact noncoprime local spectrum, including a clean if-and-only-if p^4 obstruction, gives a natural complete three-valued classification and a quantitative support error, not an arbitrary finite slice. It clarifies which congruence classes exhibit both signs and which are structurally excluded. Classical tools make the proof concise but do not make the stated full classification a mere renaming of the published support theorem.
